messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: High 5xx spike for Equinox (acct E-093) on eu-dedicated-1 starting 2024-11-07T14:12Z — paging oncall. Symptoms: generation + embeddings returning 500 for ~8-12% of requests. No auth failures. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-5xx

alice_oncall: Taking the page — checking autoscaler, pod restarts, and recent deploys. I'll post logs soon.

ben_sre: Ack. Quick grep shows repeated OOM/kernel errors on inferencer pods 3/5: `kubectl -n eu-dedicated logs inferencer-3 --since=20m | grep -i oom` — capturing stack traces now.

eva_engineer: Mirroring logs to #eng-runtime. Initial look: segfaults in quantized attention kernel after the runtime v2.8.0 push at 13:58 UTC. Possible kernel selection mismatch on this GPU driver.

clara_am: Heads up — Equinox is high-touch. Primary POC Sara <sara@equinox.com>. Also CC legal@equinox.com. They expect tailored comms for an outage. Need an internal impact blurb asap.

frank_comms: Drafting external line for status page. Proposed: "We are investigating intermittent 500 errors for inference in our EU dedicated region impacting a subset of customers. We are actively mitigating and will provide updates every 30 minutes. No evidence of data exposure." Want AM approval before publish.

dave_support: Routing/contacts: Equinox on-call +1-555-333-0123, ops escalation +44-20-5555-0101. If we need legal loop-in: legal@redwood.com.

alice_oncall: Performed rolling restart of inferencer-3 group. Two nodes came back healthy but saw lingering 5xx on ~10% of requests targeting legacy kernel path.

ben_sre: I pinned the runtime to v2.7.1 on canary nodes and bumped CPU requests for inferencer pods. Triggered a canary roll to 2 nodes (inferencer-canary). Observed 5xx down to ~2% on canary.

frank_comms: Status page snippet (for k-status): `Partial outage: Inference errors impacting EU dedicated customers (subset). Mitigation in progress. Affected customer(s): Equinox (E-093). Next update 15:05 UTC.`

clara_am: Approved status snippet. Tailored impact line for Equinox customer-facing note: "Customers may see increased latency and intermittent failed inferences; approximately 5–12% of inference requests may return errors. Batch processing jobs are affected for a small subset of accounts. No data loss."

eva_engineer: Applying mitigation: disabling new kernel optimization path on canary by setting `RW_DISABLE_KERNEL_OPT=true` env var and restarting canary nodes. Rolling if stable for 10m. Patch in flight.

ops-rotation-bot: SCHEDULE: Oncall handoff at 15:00 UTC will be alice_oncall -> ben_sre. Flagging 1h follow-up.

alice_oncall: I'll remain on until we hit sustained <1% 5xx for 30m and then send final customer note. @frank_comms hold external update until I confirm green.

frank_comms: :thumbsup: Holding. Internal note for CSMs / Account team (draft):
```
Subject: Equinox (E-093) — Inference errors in EU dedicated (ongoing)
Summary: Intermittent 500s affecting inference and embeddings for a subset of EU dedicated nodes; mitigation in progress.
Impact: ~5-12% of requests failing; search and some batch workflows degraded.
Actions: Engineering applied rollback to runtime v2.7.1 on canary and disabled kernel opt; autoscaler restarts executed.
ETA: Next update 15:05 UTC, final update when <1% 5xx sustained for 30m.
Contact: Clara (AM), alice_oncall, ben_sre.
```

clara_am: Good. Please include tailored customer contact routing in the external note: primary POC Sara, escalation number provided by support, and optional outbound call if degradation >20% and >30m.

ben_sre: Canary looks stable at 15:02 UTC — 2 nodes with v2.7.1 + RW_DISABLE_KERNEL_OPT=true showing <1.5% 5xx and normal token throughput. Starting gradual rollback of remaining nodes to pinned build.

alice_oncall: Gradual rollout in progress. Monitoring p95 latency and 5xx. Will post final when all nodes report <1% 5xx for 30m.

frank_comms: Draft external status update queued: "Mitigation applied; a rollback and kernel-path disable has reduced errors. We continue to roll the fix and will provide a final update when recovery is confirmed." Waiting for alice_oncall green.

incident-bot: ACTION: escalation checklist updated — added Equinox contacts and customer template. Pager duty: follow escalation path if errors rebound above 10% for >5m.

ben_sre: Rolling restart complete at 15:18 UTC, remaining nodes pinned. Telemetry shows stable 5xx at ~0.8% across the fleet.

alice_oncall: Confirmed stable window started 15:20 UTC. Will keep monitoring; preparing final customer note.

frank_comms: Final external message ready (hold until send):
"We resolved an issue causing intermittent 500 errors for a subset of EU dedicated inference nodes. A rollback and temporary disable of a kernel optimization path reduced errors. The incident is now mitigated; full verification complete. If you continue to see errors, contact your AM or support."

clara_am: Approved. Send to Equinox POC and publish status page update now.

alice_oncall: Publishing final status update and sending tailored email to Sara@equinox.com now. Handoff to ben_sre for postmortem and root cause.

ops-rotation-bot: NOTE: Handoff complete at 15:42 UTC. Next steps: postmortem owner @ben_sre.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Incident marked mitigated at 15:42 UTC. CRITICAL: create follow-up postmortem and customer RCA within 72 hours."
